scope: verify TrinityCore-compatible omissions in existing available terrain and navigation packages
command: forever-extractor verify-trinity-compat --terrain-package V51_PACKAGE --terrain-plan V51_PLAN --navigation-package V57_PACKAGE --navigation-plan V57_PLAN

source_profiles.navigation_source: the same v51 package and PLAN

verification.navigation: complete v57 verify-links against the same v51 source
verification.omission_identity: the unavailable-WDT set equals the navigation ROOT-absent set and is nonempty
verification.tilelist: every ROOT-absent map has a 4108-byte tilelist with 4096 absent coordinates and zero present coordinates
verification.navigation_artifacts: every ROOT-absent map has no global, no tile and zero native fallback counters
